observations: Photo 0 shows one blue, foot mounted industrial speed reducer lying on sandy ground in sunlight.
Its round ribbed housing, input flange on the left and single solid output shaft on the right look like a cycloidal (pinwheel) gear reducer.
A black nameplate is fixed on the housing, but its text is not legible in photo 0.
Lifting eye, oil filler plug and drain plug are present; the paint looks fresh, possibly a repaint over a used unit.
No electric motor is attached or visible in photo 0; the left flange is open to take a motor.
A loose black cable lies on the ground near the unit.
A dealer watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' and 'Posted on Jiji' is across the photo.

risks.risk: No motor comes with the gearbox, or the motor is a lower power than 20 hp.
risks.proof: Photo of the motor with its rating plate legible, fitted to this gearbox.

risks.risk: Rating and ratio differ from the claim, so it suits a smaller duty.

risks.if_unproven: As the smallest rating consistent with its visible size.

risks.risk: Worn or broken internal pins, bearings or cycloid discs hidden under fresh paint.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox running under its motor, or of the output shaft turned by hand through a full turn with no knock or play.
risks.if_unproven: As not working, needing a rebuild.

risks.risk: Cracked housing or broken mounting feet hidden by the angle.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and the underside of the feet.

risks.risk: Photo is a dealer stock shot, not the unit sold.
risks.proof: Photo of this unit with a paper showing the seller's name and today's date.

proof_requests: Close, sharp photo of the gearbox nameplate.
Photo of the electric motor and its rating plate, attached to the gearbox.
Clip of the motor and gearbox running.
Photos of all sides and the feet.
Photo of the unit with a dated note from the seller.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a foot mounted industrial cycloidal gear reducer, so it can be priced by type at its worst case: gearbox only without the claimed motor, rating at the low end of its size, and as not working. A legible nameplate, the motor with its plate and a running clip would raise it.
